description: The hold-back mask of the pieces of a streamed answer: what is sent is the start of the masked whole, nothing of a secret is sent before it can be masked, and the cost grows with the answer, not its square.

mutations.name: TM1
mutations.what: the last word is not held

mutations.name: TM2
mutations.what: the start of a secret is not held

mutations.name: TM3
mutations.what: the start of a secret is looked for only where the text ends with the secret's first character

mutations.name: TM5
mutations.what: the held end is never flushed

mutations.name: TM6
mutations.what: the flush sends the end unmasked

mutations.name: TM7
mutations.what: what is sent is not masked

mutations.name: TM8
mutations.what: a reset keeps the text of the cut stream

mutations.name: TM9
mutations.what: a reset is not told to the watchers

mutations.name: TM10
mutations.what: the flush does not compare what was sent with the masked whole

mutations.name: TM11
mutations.what: the text already sent is kept in the tail and sent again

mutations.name: TM12
mutations.what: the list of secrets is read once, when the mask is made

mutations.name: TM13
mutations.what: the whole-text check gives up at once instead of backing off to an earlier space

mutations.name: TM14
mutations.what: each piece is masked on its own, nothing is held (the naive per-piece mask)

mutations.name: TM15
mutations.what: a piece that only makes the last word longer is looked at too (the cost of a long word grows with its square)

mutations.name: TM16
mutations.what: the whole text is masked at every piece, not the tail (the cost grows with the square of the answer)

mutations.name: TM17
mutations.what: a held Bearer without its token is sent
